reviewer: Codex /root X core completion evidence review
rationale: Complete fresh X execution, finite saved-gradient scale, consistent tensor branches, matched L/X input budgets and per-update CPU Adam agreement support continuing the planned common-warm H1 and development comparisons under existing guards. This is a scoped judgment to continue experiments with explicit backend limitations; it does not validate the method or unresolved MUSA root cause.
limitations: Old v7 nonfinite and enormous gradients remain invalid and their root cause unresolved; no failed or diagnostic phi is reused.
Blocking is a candidate mitigation, not an established root-cause fix; preserve original lock, immutable source/input pins and saved-gradient guards.
H2 differentiates the last two steps with an earlier fixed boundary; it is not the full K-step derivative.
CPU tiny direct-chain tests support the mathematical implementation. Real BF16 differences only support coarse scale; there is no X-specific real-model finite-difference proof.
Each CPU Adam replay resets from the corresponding saved state and consumes saved gradients; neither derivatives nor a complete independent CPU trajectory are recomputed.
Matching recorded L/X input and token metadata does not prove efficacy, convergence, equal wall time or all backend derivatives.
Single training seed17 with no completed development effect comparison; method superiority, q_train benefit, formal generalization and full-protocol completion remain unproven.
Every later meta run needs its own artifact audit, optimizer replay and scientific review before continuation.
scope: Continue existing core controller into common-warm L-H1 and planned guarded comparisons; no method/backend validation claim.
